With the df5f02b9 verifier (sha256 8ac7c625...) swapped into scratch, all three single-file cases printed the same general line, so the single-file behaviour is unchanged from 2cb3e0d1; only the two-file cases moved (see edu-fcc-y1). None printed 'Vitest said' or any marker string. Judgement on the author's choice to count a failed file with only skipped or todo tests as having no assertion results: sound for the learner. Vitest marks a file failed with every test skipped when its setup throws, so the learner's test never ran against the form and the check could not read it; treating it like a load failure keeps loop-8 behaviour, keeps the suite error hidden, and cannot accept a weak test, because such a run already exits non-zero. A failed file that contains a real failed assertion is not treated as a load failure, so the unchanged-copy route is kept: a test that passes the normal run but has one real failed assertion against the unchanged control still gets only the unchanged-copy message, exit 1, also when a second learner file fails to load beside it (the decision's 'no assertion failed anywhere' clause). The reference test is still accepted with the Task 8 line and exit 0. No accept-to-reject or reject-to-accept change is possible: a test file with status failed means the control run exited non-zero, so the control was already not clean and already rejected before 7c689dd9; only the message for such a run changes, and the no-runnable branch still runs first and requires no failed file. The general message names labels inside the form, which is the decision-mandated text for every unreadable form; not re-argued here. The claim stays resolved.
